task: 13 — Close GNOME accessibility, localization, and privacy gates
summary: Added accessible names/descriptions to every actionable widget, mnemonics on primary actions, a 250 ms rate-limited ProgressAnnouncer for screen-reader announcements, routed all user-facing strings through the tr() gettext seam, removed forbidden biometric/internal wording from UI strings, added ProfileSetupView, and extended the privacy scan to cover AuthenticationView/SystemView/ProfileSetupView plus a UI-string registry scan.

accessibility_changes.accessible_names_added: Every Button, Switch, Entry, CheckButton, and activatable ActionRow now has accessible::Property::Label and most have accessible::Property::Description
accessibility_changes.mnemonics: _Start, _Stop, _Save, _Resume, _Discard, _Retry, _Profile Name, _Start Enrollment, _Save Profile, _Resume Capture — all with use_underline(true)
accessibility_changes.tooltips: Every actionable button/switch has tooltip_text explaining its action
accessibility_changes.roles: progress_label and guidance_label set to AccessibleRole::Status for screen-reader announcements; titles to Heading with Level(1); warnings to Alert
accessibility_changes.rate_limit: ProgressAnnouncer in navigation.rs gates AT-SPI announcements to 1 per 250ms (max 4/sec), matching the daemon PROGRESS_INTERVAL_MS

localization_changes.seam: pub fn tr(s: &str) -> String in lib.rs is the gettext routing point (identity in tests, catalog in prod)
localization_changes.routing: All user-facing strings in shell.rs, navigation.rs, components/*.rs, and view_model.rs Guidance labels pass through tr()
localization_changes.rtl: No set_direction(Ltr) or TextDirection::Ltr overrides; no custom CSS shipped (libadwaita handles RTL natively)
localization_changes.scaling: Essential long-form labels (guidance, privacy notice, recovery steps) use wrap(true); no fixed font_size/font-size in component sources

privacy_changes.new_helper: privacy::forbidden_words_in_ui_string(&str) -> Vec<&'static str> scans a UI string for forbidden terms
privacy_changes.new_view_type: ProfileSetupView { name_placeholder, privacy_acknowledged } added to view_model.rs and exported from lib.rs
privacy_changes.scan_coverage: AuthenticationView, SystemView, ProfileSetupView each have a dedicated forbidden_fields scan test + a mutation test injecting every forbidden substring
